title: Validated spectral numerical methods
objective: Implement P5 eigenvalue, SVD, FFT, convolution and sparse iterative functionality with residual and reconstruction validation

oracles: NumPy/SciPy differential corpus and spectral/reconstruction residuals

handoff.summary: Implemented the claimed ordinary-Python spectral package: validated Hermitian and general eigensystems, reduced SVD, radix-2/Bluestein FFT, direct/FFT convolution, canonical CSR storage, CG/BiCGSTAB solves, and one dominant Hermitian sparse eigenpair. General nonsymmetric eigensystems now require independently pivoted eigenbasis inversion, reciprocal-condition, inverse-residual, reconstruction, eigenpair-residual, and Schur witnesses; defective and near-defective bases fail closed with validation_failed and no value. Added CPython/Sage.js correctness, failure, metamorphic, cancellation and budget tests; 312 NumPy/SciPy differential comparisons; strict Python checks; benchmark/payload evidence; capability classifications; and documentation.
risks: Four-platform qualification remains an integration/release responsibility; focused receipts in this task are Linux x64.

The full architecture aggregate is recorded failing before spectral checks because the synchronized numerical foundation adds bench/numerical-optimization/callback-probe.c without a regenerated shared native-boundary snapshot. That shared inventory is outside this lane's claims.

Current-main merge checking also rejects src/lib/sagejs/numerics/spectral/__init__.py until the shared package graph assigns it exactly one owner. The five new modules are strict-clean but are not yet listed in the shared pyrightconfig because both registries are outside this lane's claims.
next_steps: In the integration lane, add a lazy numerical-spectral package-graph component (layer 5, at least a 150000-byte source budget) for prefix src/lib/sagejs/numerics/spectral/, module sagejs.numerics.spectral, depending on core-runtime, python-stdlib, and numerical-computing.
In the integration lane, add all five src/lib/sagejs/numerics/spectral/*.py modules to pyrightconfig.json and connect the package tests/public numerical capability registry as appropriate.

Regenerate and review the shared native-boundary inventory for the inherited numerical-optimization callback probe, then rerun pnpm architecture:check, pnpm test:changed, and the required four-platform qualification.
